description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractBasicDBMapper' responsible for mapping BSON documents to JSON values, with functionality to revise JSON key names during the conversion process.

classes.name: AbstractBasicDBMapper
classes.description: An abstract class that maps BSON documents to JSON values, allowing key name revision during the mapping process.

methods.name: mapBsonDocumentToJsonObject
methods.description: Converts a BsonDocument to a JsonObject, revising key names as specified.

methods.name: mapBsonArrayToJsonArray
methods.description: Converts a BsonArray to a JsonArray, applying key name revision to contained values.

methods.name: reviseKeyName
methods.description: Revises a JSON key name using the provided reviser function.

methods.name: mapBsonValueToJsonValue
methods.description: Maps a BsonValue to a corresponding JsonValue, handling various BSON types.

methods.name: mapBsonNumberToJsonNumber
methods.description: Converts a BsonNumber to a JsonValue of appropriate numeric type.
